mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 38 degrees and overcast at Harriet Park. While the moon phase is a Waning Gibbous, please note that the ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

Important news for those interested in local government: candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election are now available at City Hall for all four Aldermanic Districts. Completed forms must be returned by January 5, 2027.

There is a busy schedule of local events ahead. Today you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy the ART House 360 Thursday Night programming, or attend Hop Haus Trivia. Looking into tomorrow, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run or celebrate 50 years of craft brewing at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Reviewing the weekly police report, on November 2, officers were dispatched to a domestic disturbance where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
The restaurant is unfortunately closed for today. However, you can look forward to Snickers Swirl being the flavor of the day tomorrow, when doors open at 10:00 AM.
